entities.summary: Theophilos Erotikos was an 11th-century Byzantine strategos (general) and governor of Serbia and then Cyprus. In 1038, as governor of Serbia, he was ousted by a local rebellion against the imperial rule and its Serbian supporters. In 1042, as governor of the theme of Cyprus, Erotikos incited his subjects to rebel against imperial rule. His rebellion was quashed and he was punished by public humiliation in the imperial capital Constantinople.
